meta.documentName: Contribution Déterminée au niveau National actualisée (CDN 3.0)
meta.generationNote: Submitted October 2025 — classified 3rd generation per tracker rule (any submission since November 2024), regardless of document title/version.

rows.verbatim: le Cameroun entend réduire ses émissions de GES à hauteur de 38 % soit 13% inconditionnel ... d'ici 2030 en cohérence avec les cibles de la SND 30
rows.translation: Cameroon intends to reduce its GHG emissions by 38%, of which 13% unconditional, by 2030 in line with the SND 30 targets

rows.verbatim: le Cameroun entend réduire ses émissions de GES à hauteur de 38 % soit ... 25% conditionnel (avec une réduction de 45101.69 Gg CO₂eq par rapport au BAU) d'ici 2030
rows.translation: Cameroon intends to reduce its GHG emissions by 38%, of which 25% conditional (a reduction of 45,101.69 Gg CO2eq vs BAU) by 2030

rows.verbatim: et de 41% soit 14% inconditionnel ... ( avec une réduction de 63157.46 Gg CO₂eq par rapport au BAU) d'ici 2035 aligné sur le paragraphe 37 du « Global StockTake »
rows.translation: and 41%, of which 14% unconditional (a reduction of 63,157.46 Gg CO2eq vs BAU) by 2035, aligned with paragraph 37 of the Global Stocktake

rows.verbatim: et de 41% soit ... 27% conditionnel ( avec une réduction de 63157.46 Gg CO₂eq par rapport au BAU) d'ici 2035
rows.translation: and 41%, of which 27% conditional (a reduction of 63,157.46 Gg CO2eq vs BAU) by 2035

rows.verbatim: Porter à 25 % la part des énergies renouvelables hors grande hydro dans le bouquet électrique en 2035
rows.translation: Raise the share of renewables excluding large hydro to 25% of the electricity mix by 2035
rows.note: Conditionality = Unclear: the target statement itself does not declare conditionality (tracker convention).

rows.verbatim: Améliorer l'accès des populations et des industries à l'électricité en quadruplant la capacité de production à l'horizon 2035 pour passer à 6 GW
rows.translation: Improve access to electricity for people and industry by quadrupling generation capacity to 6 GW by 2035

rows.verbatim: la réalisation de ses objectifs de neutralité carbone et de résilience d'ici 2050
rows.translation: the achievement of its carbon neutrality and resilience objectives by 2050
rows.note: JUDGMENT CALL: appears in a narrative about the institutional framework, not stated as a formal economy-wide net-zero commitment (no defined scope/pathway). The country also presents itself as a net carbon sink. Default = reject unless you decide it qualifies.

rows.verbatim: Favorisation de l'achat de véhicules peu polluants
rows.translation: Encouraging the purchase of low-polluting vehicles
rows.note: Split from a bundled sentence ('Favorisation de l'achat de véhicules peu polluants et mise au rebut des véhicules plus polluants'). This is the purchase-incentive half.

rows.verbatim: mise au rebut des véhicules plus polluants via des normes, incitations ou obligations
rows.translation: scrapping of more polluting vehicles via standards, incentives or obligations
rows.note: Split from the same bundled sentence. This is the scrappage half.

rows.verbatim: Promotion des modes de transport à faible émission carbone
rows.translation: Promotion of low-carbon transport modes
rows.note: Vague ('low-carbon modes'), no specific action. Classified as general TDM; consider dropping if too non-specific for the database.

rows.verbatim: Services d'autobus Express
rows.translation: Express bus services
rows.note: Listed among energy-efficiency reduction options; mapped to PT priority/express services.

rows.verbatim: Bus à Transite Rapide (BRT)
rows.translation: Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) — 50 km of lines (2030), 80 km (2035); Douala and Yaoundé
rows.note: Quantified: 50 km by 2030, 80 km by 2035, in Douala and Yaoundé.

rows.verbatim: Substitution de voitures personnelles à énergies fossiles aux voitures électriques
rows.translation: Replacement of fossil-fuel private cars with electric cars — 500 EVs (2030), 900 EVs (2035)

rows.verbatim: Mise en circulation des autobus électriques de 18 m
rows.translation: Introduction of 18m electric buses — 200 (2030), 400 (2035)

rows.verbatim: Substitution de transport individuel par le transport de massse (trains, covoiturage etc.)
rows.translation: Replacement of individual transport by mass transit (trains, carpooling etc.) — 2,000 persons/day (2030), 3,500 (2035)
rows.note: Bundled (mass transit by train + carpooling). Duplicate this row for a Digital solutions > shared mobility classification of the carpooling element if you want both captured.

rows.verbatim: Mise en circulation des voitures fontionants au gaz naturel
rows.translation: Introduction of natural-gas vehicles — 500 (2030), 1,000 (2035)

rows.verbatim: Construction d'une usine de production d'hydrogène et ammoniac
rows.translation: Construction of a hydrogen and ammonia production plant (Kribi)
rows.note: Located in Kribi; both passenger/freight relevance unclear. Hydrogen production plant — included as alternative-fuels support; review whether it meets the transport-measure bar.

rows.verbatim: Mise en place d'un système de transport multimodal bas carbone en milieu urbain
rows.translation: Establishment of a low-carbon multimodal transport system in urban areas (stated co-benefit: reduction of transport-sector GHG)
rows.note: MITIGATION TWIN of adaptation row: this appears in the adaptation table but its stated co-benefit is transport GHG reduction, so it is captured in both domains per tracker convention.

rows.verbatim: Mise en place d'un système de transport multimodal bas carbone en milieu urbain
rows.translation: Establishment of a low-carbon multimodal transport system in urban areas
rows.note: ADAPTATION TWIN of mitigation co-benefit row above (same verbatim).

rows.verbatim: Construction des infrastructures résilientes au climat et renforcement de la résilience des systèmes et des corridors de transport nationaux, (régionaux, urbains et ruraux)
rows.translation: Construction of climate-resilient infrastructure and strengthening the resilience of national (regional, urban and rural) transport systems and corridors
rows.note: Mode: corridors imply road primarily; adjust if rail corridors intended.

rows.verbatim: Mise en place d'un système de transport multimodal bas carbone en milieu urbain
rows.translation: Low-carbon urban multimodal transport system — stated co-benefit: reduction of transport-sector GHG
rows.note: The stated co-benefit is transport-GHG reduction; nearest benefit tag in the taxonomy is air pollution reduction. Review whether this should be tagged at all (GHG reduction is the measure's purpose, not a co-benefit per se).

rows.verbatim: Promouvoir la participation des femmes et jeunes dans la planification et la gestion du transport durable (Co-Bénéfices: Réduction de la pollution urbaine)
rows.translation: Promote the participation of women and youth in sustainable transport planning and management (co-benefit: reduction of urban pollution)
rows.note: From the gender table (p44/45). The action is workforce participation, not a transport measure per se, but it carries an explicit urban-pollution co-benefit. Included for your review — likely a benefit-only tag or a drop.

rows.verbatim: Appuyer les initiatives de mobilité verte dirigées par des groupes vulnérables (taxi solaire, vélo électrique) (Co-Bénéfices: Inclusion socioéconomique)
rows.translation: Support green-mobility initiatives led by vulnerable groups (solar taxi, electric bike) (co-benefit: socio-economic inclusion)
rows.note: From the gender table. Carries an explicit social-inclusion co-benefit linked to a transport action (solar taxi, e-bike). Review for inclusion.
